snippet.title: Vastophobia Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Showcase of early build of Vastophobia
play the demo here
store.steampowered.com/app/3558470/Vastophobia/
metalvenomuk.itch.io/vastophobia

Vastophobia is a new project about exploring liminal space's , focusing on atmosphere and mild threats (no jump scares here). using the power of unreal to achieve this.

music by Scott Buckley
www.scottbuckley.com.au/
